content.short: MetaGame is a community focused on making the Metaverse more inclusive while remaining fun and profitable.
content.description: MetaGame is an organization of builders who organize events and provide tools for people building the Metaverse. Users can participate in creating elements of the metaverse—content for where they'll live, play, and work in the future. Developers can use MetaGame's tools to integrate their worlds and access larger environments. MetaGame advances decentralization and autonomy, helping people build the future they want to live in.
